about: Planted issues in sample-client/tallo, one id per issue. Written with the data, before any blind run was scored. Each issue is discoverable only by reading the exports (often by joining two of them); the notes columns are neutral. 'checklist' is the Phase 0 label that should catch it.

google.issue: The value event First Deposit is Secondary in CZ and SK; the account bids on installs (and CZ web sign-up)
PL has no First Deposit conversion action at all
PL counts installs twice: Install (MMP) and first_open (Firebase) both Primary
PL app conversions carry EEA consent signals on 0% of conversions
The CZ negative list is attached to the brand campaign only, not to the generic Search campaign
Off-intent zero-conversion terms with real spend in CZ generic Search (mortgage calculator, bitcoin price, instant loan)
CZ PMax has no brand exclusions and buys brand queries
PL auto-apply is on and has changed a budget and added broad keywords
Budget changes without a ledger row or approver: SK 35 to 70 by a Standard user, PL 60 to 90 auto-applied
The former agency still has Admin on CZ and SK after the contract ended
The 2023 generic campaign promises no fees / free forever; current pricing is EUR 1.99/month
SK headline promises a guaranteed 8 % yearly return on an investment product
The guaranteed-return line was copied into PL (guardrail 9)
The prize-draw mechanic was copied from SK into PL without a local check (guardrail 10)
PL: 655 Google installs vs 44 in the MMP, with MMP organic up from 720 to 1,310
Polish token dowod_spoleczny in a PL campaign and ad group name (hygiene)

meta.issue: The Tallo CZ portfolio has a single admin
The former agency has full control of the Tallo CZ portfolio
One card, billed to the CZ entity, pays the PL entity's account in another portfolio
App installs arrive from both the Meta SDK and the MMP
first_deposit (the value event) is not mapped to a standard event; every ad set optimizes on installs
SK: six ad sets at EUR 8/day, all Learning limited
CZ winter ad set at frequency 5.6 with CTR halved and CPM up
PL promo Android ad set does not exclude existing users
PL ad promises a guaranteed 8 % yearly return
PL budget 40 to 100 (+150 %) with no ledger row and far over the ~20 % step
One CZ ad set on 1-day click, the rest on 7-day click
Polish token dowod_spoleczny in a PL campaign/ad set name (hygiene)
